share.instructionsEdit:
Hi! I'm sharing my flight history with you.

📱 HOW TO OPEN:
1. Tap the link you received
2. Start the Telegram Mini App with "Start"
3. Tap "Run App"
4. Done! You can view and edit my flight history.

🔗 Link:
share.instructionsView:
Hi! I'm sharing my flight history with you.

🌐 HOW TO OPEN:
In a browser:
1. Open the link in any browser — it will load automatically.
2. Done! You can view my flight history.

In Telegram Mini App:
1. Open the Mini App
2. Go to History → Join
3. Paste the link in the field
4. Done! You can view my flight history.

🔗 Link:
